name: – Tomas Tobé – After § 56 – Am 44
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 56b. Notes with concern the structural and personnel links between the Turkish-Islamic Union for Religious Affairs (DITIB) and Türkiye’s Presidency of Religious Affairs (Diyanet), including imams employed by the Turkish State; calls for full transparency regarding DITIB’s governance, financing, personnel and instructions from third-country authorities; calls for the completion of the agreed phase-out of Turkish state-employed imams; stresses that public funding and participation in consultative structures should be conditional on organisational independence from third-country governments, with full respect for freedom of religion;
